#Mandatory AI Usage Report

##AI TOOL USED: ChatGPT,ClaudeAI

##WHAT I ASKED AI TO DO:
Help design and improve the frontend UI for the Smart Attendance Management System.
Help write and debug JavaScript code for connecting the frontend with Spring Boot REST APIs.
Help generate sample student and subject data for testing the application.


##PROMPT THAT WAS MOST USEFUL:
"Create a simple and professional attendance management dashboard using HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and connect it with my Spring Boot REST APIs."


##CODE GENERATED BY AI: What part?
HTML/CSS dashboard structure and JavaScript functions for loading students, marking attendance, displaying attendance records, summaries, and low-attendance students.


##CODE I MODIFIED: What part?
I modified the API endpoints, input fields, sample data, and adjusted the JavaScript according to my Spring Boot backend and database structure.


##AI OUTPUT THAT WAS WRONG:
The initial dashboard code used incorrect CSS selectors, and some API-related code did not exactly match my backend structure.


##HOW I IDENTIFIED THE PROBLEM:
I ran the application and checked the browser output, API responses, Postman, and Spring Boot console. I also checked whether the frontend was receiving data from the backend.


##HOW I FIXED IT:
I corrected the CSS selectors, updated the API URLs/endpoints to match my Spring Boot application, tested the APIs using Postman, and modified the JavaScript based on the actual response data.
